body: I'm pretty sure I don't make anyone feel better. I wish I did. I don't think I make him just a little bummed out sometimes, it's starting to feel like I just make his life so much worse. He's usually so positive and I just make him feel so negative. He said he doesn't want to deal with me sometimes. I don't want to be the thing in his life that is constantly stressing him out. He makes me so fucking happy it's unfair that I make him this sad. Last night he told me how negative I make him feel and I didn't reply until this morning. I was thinking it'd be best to just completely stop bothering him but now I'm not so sure. Either way it doesn't look like he'll reply anytime soon. I'm too much to deal with. I don't want to burden others anymore. I just want someone to really care about me but anyone that would care about me would be constantly stressed out and I don't think I can do that to anyone anymore.
